# pve_sdn_status (Data Source)

Runtime SDN state on a node: zones (plus bridges/content/ip-vrf per zone), vnets (plus mac-vrf), and fabric interfaces/neighbors/routes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_status" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `fabric` (Attributes List) Identifier for SDN fabrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabric))
- `vnet` (Attributes List) The SDN vnet object identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vnet))
- `zone` (Attributes List) The SDN zone object identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zone))

### Read-Only

- `bridges` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/zones/{zone}/bridges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bridges))
- `content` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/zones/{zone}/content. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<zone>/<vnet>/<fabric>.
- `index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `ip_vrf` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/zones/{zone}/ip-vrf. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_vrf))
- `mac_vrf` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/mac-vrf. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mac_vrf))
- `neighbors` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/neighbors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neighbors))
- `routes` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `zones` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/sdn/zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--bridges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bridges`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the bridge.
- `ports` (Attributes List) All ports that are members of the bridge (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bridges--ports))
- `vlan_filtering` (String) Whether VLAN filtering is enabled for this bridge (= VLAN-aware).

<a id="nestedatt--bridges--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bridges.ports`

Read-Only:

- `index` (String) The index of the guests network device that this interface belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the bridge port.
- `primary_vlan` (Number) The primary VLAN configured for the port of this bridge (= PVID). Only for VLAN-aware bridges.
- `vlans` (List of String) A list of VLANs and VLAN ranges that are allowed for this bridge port in addition to the primary VLAN. Only for VLAN-aware bridges.
- `vmid` (Number) The ID of the guest that this interface belongs to.



<a id="nestedatt--content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Status.
- `statusmsg` (String) Status details
- `vnet` (String) Vnet identifier.


<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the network interface.
- `state` (String) The current state of the interface.
- `type` (String) The type of this interface in the fabric (e.g. Point-to-Point, Broadcast, ..).


<a id="nestedatt--ip_vrf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_vrf`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) The CIDR of the route table entry.
- `metric` (Number) This route's metric.
- `nexthops` (List of String) A list of nexthops for the route table entry.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol where this route was learned from (e.g. BGP).


<a id="nestedatt--mac_vrf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mac_vrf`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) The IP address of the MAC VRF entry.
- `mac` (String) The MAC address of the MAC VRF entry.
- `nexthop` (String) The IP address of the nexthop.


<a id="nestedatt--neighbors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `neighbors`

Read-Only:

- `neighbor` (String) The IP or hostname of the neighbor.
- `status` (String) The status of the neighbor, as returned by FRR.
- `uptime` (String) The uptime of this neighbor, as returned by FRR (e.g. 8h24m12s).


<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `route` (String) The CIDR block for this routing table entry.
- `via` (List of String) A list of nexthops for that route.


<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Status of zone
- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier.
